 Thai BL Stars Joong-Dunk, Aou-Boom Split; Announcement Leaves Fans Heartbroken
 GMMTV on Monday afternoon took to their official social media handles to announce that two of their most beloved on-screen BL (Boys’ Love) pairing Joong-Dunk and Aou-Boom have mutually decided to go their separate ways. The news has come across as shocking to their fans, leaving the internet buzzing with speculation and unconfirmed theories.
 By   Aashna Nadkarni   
  Oct. 19, 2026 
 >
 Entertainment
 Fans of Thai entertainment industry were in for a world of shock on Monday afternoon, when GMMTV took to their official social media handles to announce that two of their most beloved on-screen BL (Boys’ Love) pairing Joong-Dunk ( Joong Archen Aydin and Dunk Natachai Boonprasert ) and Aou-Boom ( Aou Thanaboon Kiatniran and Boom Tharatorn Jantharaworakarn ) have mutually decided to go their separate ways. It is safe to say that the shocking news has left the internet buzzing with speculation and unconfirmed theories.
 Joong-Dunk, Aou-Boom Mutually Split 
 Releasing official statements, written in Thai and English, on their official Instagram and X (formerly known as Twitter) handles, GMMTV , on Monday, stated that Joong-Dunk and Aou-Boom have decided to conclude their work together as a BL pair and go their separate ways so that they could pursue their individual career directions.
 SEE ALSO: Thai Actors Fourth Nattawat, Gemini Norawit’s Indian Fans Ask For Apology Over Viral Video; But Why? 
 The statement goes on to add, “Each decision was made with mutual understanding and respect, taking into account each artist’s career path and future goals.” It went on to add that the on-screen pairings’ previously announced activities would be proceeding as per schedule.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by GMMTV (@gmmtv) 
 “The company extends its gratitude for the ongoing love and support shown to the four artists and sincerely hopes that this will continue in their future endeavors,” the statement concluded.
 Fans Reacts 
 Well it is safe to say that Joong-Dunk and Aou-Boom’s fans were left heartbroken over the announcement. One wrote, “Gosh this hurt but, as long as all of them are fine, it’s okay, ty for this guys, we love you and support you.” Another wrote, “As if one breakup per this cruel post was not enough we got TWO from now on!” One said, “Whaaaat?! That was not what i expected to see... My heart is totally brokendon’t fucking talk to me today joongdunk and aouboom just broke up.”
 Sending warm support to Joong, Dunk, Aou and Boom. I’m sad the pair projects are ending, but I respect your choice. Thank you for the memories — looking forward to your new individual journeys! #JoongDunk #AouBoomDeserveBetter #JAIDEE #CERI #GMMTV https://t.co/tUsB4lBM27
— dani.sophiaKatseye (@Castrov1Danilyn) October 19, 2026 
 Hoje, muitos fãs foram surpreendidos por um anúncio que, sem dúvida, traz sentimentos difíceis de explicar. #JoongDunk e #AouBoom fizeram parte de tantas histórias, momentos e lembranças que vão muito além dos trabalhos que acompanharam juntos. Por isso, é compreensível sentir tristeza, choque, saudade e até dificuldade para aceitar essa mudança. Sabemos que, por trás de cada dupla, existem anos de carinho, apoio e sonhos construídos junto com os fãs. Não é fácil se despedir de uma fase que significou tanto, e ninguém precisa fingir que está tudo bem ou superar isso de uma hora para outra. Mas, neste momento, também é importante respeitar as decisões dos quatro artistas e lembrar que, antes de serem duplas, eles são pessoas com seus próprios caminhos, sentimentos e objetivos. O fim de uma parceria profissional não apaga as lembranças, o carinho nem tudo o que foi vivido até aqui. Aos fãs de JoongDunk e AouBoom, permitam-se sentir. Acolham uns aos outros, respeitem o tempo de cada pessoa e não diminuam o sentimento de ninguém. Cada um vai lidar com essa notícia à sua maneira, e tudo bem. Que possamos continuar desejando coisas boas a Joong, Dunk, Aou e Boom, individualmente, levando conosco as memórias bonitas que essas duplas nos proporcionaram. 🤍
— Jasper Portal BR 🇧🇷 (@JasperPortalBR) October 19, 2026

 What About Their Shows? 
 While both fandoms had an inkling about the distance between the four artists, they had kept on hoping that Joong-Dunk would return stronger with their show How To Survive My CEO , and Aou-Boom’s with Billionaire Biker , their first series as a main-lead couple. It is to be noted that both shows were announced during the GMMTV 2026 Line-Up Announcement. The future of the shows remains uncertain.
